notes.title: IMSCARED small update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11805398/2109a5f7bb7029109d1a665db8074ddf914f698a.png[/img]
[i]Hey[/i]a[i],[/i] long time no see! Have you enjoyed your nightmares thus far?

Thanks to the hel[i]p[/i] of [b]Kuro2427[/b], [b]meedokzy[/b], [b]Doresun[/b] and [b]L[i]a[/i]st penguin[/b], IMSCA[i]R[/i]ED is finally available in Brazilian-Por[i]t[/i]uguese and Russia[i]n[/i]! I'll add mor[i]e[/i] localizations in the futu[i]r[/i]e, but we'll talk more about that in a dedicated Discussion[i]![/i]

I've [i]al[/i]so fixed so[i]m[/i]e stuff d[i]o[/i]wn the line, but my memory is failing me more than ever... [i]S[/i]heesh, I'm ge[i]t[/i]ting ol[i]d[/i].
Please let me kn[i]o[/i]w if there's a[i]n[/i]y probl[i]e[/i]m with this update[i],[/i] I'll try to [i]s[/i]olv[i]e[/i] anything as soon as possibl[i]e[/i]!

I'm also tr[i]y[/i]ing t[i]o[/i] solve the nefario[i]u[/i]s issue f[i]o[/i]r which the game closes but Steam still perceives it as ope[i]n[/i], I don'[i]t[/i] t[i]h[/i]ink I can do anything about it, but I'll try non[i]e[/i]theless.

Lastly, I would like to p[i]r[/i]esent y[i]o[/i]u my Patre[i]o[/i]n page: I'm uploading all my weird and/or canned projects there, [i]f[/i]eel free [i]to[/i] check it out if you want to stay in touch with my future [i]p[/i]rojects! (the o[i]n[/i]ly gam[i]e[/i] available there is the reason for which I went radio silent). But don't worry, if you're one of those e[i]x[/i]quisi[i]t[/i]e people that followed the rabbit in the streets you already know we're not done with I[i]M[/i]SCARED[i].[/i]

Thanks a bunch f[i]o[/i]r sticking with IMSCARED up to this poi[i]n[/i]t, and sorry for all the wai[i]t[/i]. Life can be messy and mine is really taking a toll on me, but I suppose you s[i]h[/i]ould just keep pushing onwards. So onwards we'll go[i]![/i]


Ivan

Edit: forgot to put the patreon page here, I told you I'm losing my mind ain't I? ːcoolfaceː

notes.title: IMSCARED 2022 UPDATE

tags.feature: The game finally has an Options menu, which you can access in the start screen;
...And Legacy options! You can select the old 2012 framerate & footsteps sfx, if you're a purist;
Changed the way IMSCARED manages languages files. Expect more translations soon;
Gamepad is now partially supported, but I suggest you to play with a keyboard while I finalize the thing;
Steam cards, background and emojis are now available (but I'm pretty sure some of you already received a big pack of cards by now);
